## What it is

The tower at 90°, the back, +Y. Recessed 1. This one carries the lowest clip. Start the tube here.

## Design notes

- The running rib is 6.0 mm radial by 3.2 mm tangential. The clips are local. Raise `rib_radial` first if it flexes.
- Print it on its side, same reason as the other towers: the snap arms stay in the layers.
- The cable hole is about 20° before this tower. The helix climbs counterclockwise from that hole into the lowest clip.
- The 1 is recessed 0.6 mm into the top face of the rib. The foot is the same tab as the other towers.
- The spoke is 6 mm along the tower and crosses the whole 6 mm rib. A 45° gusset, 3 mm on a side, is added at the outer face. The bore and the mouth are unchanged.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't start the coil on a different tower. The other three are a quarter turn higher, each in turn.
- Don't print it standing up.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-08: first 90° tower. Lowest clip.
- 2026-11-08: notches and lug replaced by a recessed 1. Same slot as the others.
- 2026-11-08: spoke widened to the rib and a 45° gusset added at the tower.
